title: Proposal to Deploy Smaller and More Discreet Surveillance Cameras for Capturing High-rise Littering
what_it_is: Proposal to Deploy Smaller and More Discreet Surveillance Cameras for Capturing High-rise Littering

sections.label: NEA camera technology enforcement
sections.summary: NEA keeps pace with camera technology developments and will consider surveillance equipment effectiveness comprehensively in its adoption.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) is continually looking to enhance its enforcement capabilities, including for high-rise littering surveillance, by keeping pace with the latest developments in camera technology.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Cameras that are smaller in size tended to have a shorter optical range and duration.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA will consider the effectiveness of surveillance equipment comprehensively in its adoption.

sections.label: Camera deployment distance and duration
sections.summary: Cameras are deployed a distance away, at ground level where possible, over surveillance durations of five days or more.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, we continue to look at developments in camera technology for more effective and better deployment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But in the mean time, to make it less conspicuous, we deploy the camera quite a distance away from the suspected units.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We try to deploy at ground level where site conditions permit and, only in cases where this is not possible, do we look for an adjacent block to deploy the camera.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For instance, you need to deploy the camera over a sufficient surveillance duration, which is maybe, a few days; five days or even more.

sections.label: Camera system size and efficacy
sections.summary: The entire system comprises the camera plus battery pack, with a trade-off between size and efficacy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Actually, it is not just the size of the camera but the entire system, which comprises the camera plus the battery pack.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: There is also this trade-off between size and efficacy.

sections.label: Smaller cameras limitations
sections.summary: Smaller cameras mean shorter surveillance duration capabilities and very limited optical range.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: At the moment, smaller cameras mean shorter surveillance duration capabilities as well as very limited optical range.
